verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's REST API can retrieve session history for a chosen time range and is documented for collecting session logs. Its official open-source Python module exports session data to CSV, and the management portal supports monitoring sessions, so the core audit-log-and-export capability is first-party. Export runs through the API or scripts rather than a documented one-click audit export. missing for 10: explicit documentation that session records include the connecting user, target machine and timestamps; a documented native portal export; independent or hands-on corroboration.
